QuestInfo.name: Mage (Ice, Lightning)
QuestInfo.0: Ask Robeira about becoming a Mage.
QuestInfo.1: To become a Mage, you must touch the Holy Stone at the Holy Ground in the Snowfield. You can get there from #rSharp Cliff I#k.\n\n#i4031059##t4031059# #b#c4031059# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You have become a Mage (Ice, Lightning)!

0.0: The test is simple. You are to go to a special place, defeat an enemy there, and return with the loot from that battle. Simple, but not easy...
0.1: Go to the #bHoly Ground at the Snowfield#k. If you touch the special stone there, you will be warped into #banother dimension#k, and your enemy will be waiting...
0.2: Go to Sharp Cliff I. The path to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield is behind the obelisk. Good luck.
0.3: This should be interesting... Heh.\r\n#b(You will be moved to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield if you accept.)#k

no.0: If you're afraid of a little test, how do you expect to survive Ossyria?
